items.title: Tim Ries interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 19, 2022
items.q: And Chuck Leavell is the musical director. So he’ll look at okay the last time we were in this city we did these songs...

ctx.x: Do they ever make game time decisions like change their mind about a song list — “Let’s insert this now?”

Well we don’t get the song list until like right before the show. So like day of the show will be kind of like — show’s at — like maybe by six or something then we get the set list. So every city has its own reasons for that song. Maybe we’re in Detroit and we’re going to do a Motown tune. Maybe we’re in Nashville or maybe we’ll do one of their country things. You know so it depends on where we are. And Chuck Leavell is the musical director. So he’ll look at okay the last time we were in this city we did these…
time so let’s do this one this time. So it’s kind of like, so like we do a sound check and then by six here’s the set list. Oh cool, we’re doing this.
